As Facebook (FB) Stock Declined, Clear Harbor Asset Management Has Lifted by $1.30 Million Its Position; Alley Company Lowered Amazon Com (AMZN) Holding by $397,925 as Market Value Rose
June 1, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Alley Company Llc decreased its stake in Amazon Com Inc (AMZN) by 6.06% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Alley Company Llc sold 275 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.80% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 4,266 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.17 million, down from 4,541 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Alley Company Llc who had been investing in Amazon Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $790.74 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.29% or $4.73 during the last trading session, reaching $1629.62. About 2.81 million shares traded. Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) has risen 62.09% since June 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 49.52% the S&P500.
Clear Harbor Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 202.11% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Clear Harbor Asset Management Llc bought 8,145 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.01% with the market. The institutional investor held 12,175 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.95M, up from 4,030 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Clear Harbor Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $555.13 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.19% or $4.11 during the last trading session, reaching $191.78. About 22.97M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% since June 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
Clear Harbor Asset Management Llc, which manages about $493.82M and $511.82M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Axis Capital Holdings Ltd (NYSE:AXS) by 22,278 shares to 118,433 shares, valued at $6.82 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Ashford Hospitality Tr Inc (NYSE:AHT) by 60,635 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 149,468 shares, and cut its stake in Crestwood Equity Partners Lp.
